title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 14
description:
At Jeminise, we offer this comfortable and durable Comforter Set, perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers. Show your determination with this unique bedding set, designed to add a sporty touch to any room.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: A perfect gift for men and women, moms and dads, ideal for Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process that prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Microfiber Filling: Includes whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing.
  • Personalized Design: Features a "Baseball Thunder" color and "Baseball" pattern, with options for 2 text inputs for personalization.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization 2 text inputs
